summary: Tested Ghosting Protocol (Phase C) for ParKaro valet platform. All 11 backend API tests passed. All frontend UI tests passed. Features tested: arrived status sets arrived_at timestamp, returned status sets returned_at and resets vehicle to 'parked', completed status marks vehicle as 'checked_out', timer countdown display, button state changes based on timer, return to park form with zone/GPS capture, WhatsApp notifications sent on status changes.
passed_tests: Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status?status=arrived sets arrived_at timestamp
Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status?status=returned sets returned_at timestamp
Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status?status=returned resets vehicle to 'parked' status
Backend: Returned vehicle can be retrieved again later
Backend: PUT /api/tickets/{id}/status?status=completed marks vehicle as 'checked_out'
Backend: PUT /api/vehicles/{id}/location updates vehicle location
Backend: Full ghosting flow (park → retrieve → arrived → return) works end-to-end
Backend: Valet dashboard stats endpoint still works
Backend: Status transition claimed → arrived works
Backend: Status transition arrived → completed works
Backend: Status transition arrived → returned works
Frontend: Login with OTP works
Frontend: Dashboard shows active tickets with ARRIVED/CLAIMED status badges
Frontend: Ticket detail page shows 5-minute countdown timer when status is 'arrived'
Frontend: Timer card shows amber color with 'WAITING FOR CUSTOMER' text
Frontend: Before timer expires: 'HANDOVER COMPLETE' button is primary green
Frontend: Before timer expires: 'Return to different spot' button is secondary amber
Frontend: Return to park form shows with zone input and GPS capture option
Frontend: Return to park form has Cancel button
Frontend: Return to park successfully updates ticket status to 'returned'
Frontend: Success toast 'Vehicle returned to new location!' appears after return
Frontend: Dashboard stats cards (VEHICLES, TIPS TODAY, ACTIVE VALETS) visible
Frontend: FAB button visible at bottom of dashboard
seed_data_creation: Created test vehicles with TEST-GHOST-* and TEST-TRANS-* prefixes during backend testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ghosting Protocol (Phase C) is fully working. Key features: 1) When ticket status is 'arrived', a 5-minute countdown timer starts (arrived_at timestamp set). 2) Timer card shows amber color with countdown, changes to red with 'TIME UP' when timer reaches 0. 3) Before timer expires: green 'HANDOVER COMPLETE' button is primary, amber 'Return to different spot' is secondary. 4) After timer expires: red 'RETURN TO PARK (GHOSTED)' button becomes primary (data-testid: ghost-return-button), 'Complete Handover' becomes secondary. 5) Return form allows setting new zone/location with optional GPS capture. 6) After return, ticket status is 'returned', vehicle status resets to 'parked', WhatsApp notification sent to customer. 7) Vehicle can be retrieved again after being ghosted. Key data-testids: ghost-return-button, handover-button, return-button, arrived-button, back-button. Tips/payment via Razorpay is MOCKED (not configured).
